name: Poisson multivariate adaptive shrinkage (Poisson mash)
model_likelihood: x_jr independently Poisson(s_r lambda_jr); log lambda_jr = mu_j + beta_jr
prior: Mixture of zero-centered multivariate normals with covariance w_l U_k and learned mixture weights
inference_algorithm: Gaussian-mixture variational approximation; EM-like coordinate ascent on the ELBO
estimand: Approximate posterior LFC means and covariances; optional ELBO-based Bayes factor
data_input: Gene-by-condition pseudobulk UMI count matrix and positive size factors
tunable_settings: Scale grid w_l; canonical covariance patterns; convergence criterion
